prompt:
Instruct: Represent the passage for semantic similarity with respect to this condition: {condition}
Query: {passage}

principles.definition: Compare expected lives saved with equal weight for each person, ignoring consent and how identical work costs are distributed.
principles.paraphrase: Match the total expected prevention of death, counting everyone equally; disregard voluntary choice and the allocation of work.

principles.definition: Compare whether the workers give informed, unpressured consent and can refuse, ignoring lives saved and work distribution.
principles.paraphrase: Match the workers' knowledge and freedom to decline participation; disregard the outcome totals and allocation of burdens.

principles.definition: Compare how work burdens are divided among four equally responsible workers, ignoring consent and lives saved.
principles.paraphrase: Match the distribution of required work across people with the same responsibilities; disregard voluntariness and outcome totals.

assumptions: Synthetic outcome numbers are expected deaths averted; equal value per life.
All workers are equally responsible and face identical linear disutility per work hour; sixteen work hours total in every case.
Autonomy of the four workers is separate from recipients' outcomes.
Partial resemblance orders under declared interpretations, not complete ethical theories or uniquely determined moral ratings.

geometry.features: 64-dimensional train-only PCA basis per paired bootstrap seed10,11,12; normalized projected Qwen vectors
geometry.objective: mean squared error to cleaned [0,1] targets plus .001*mean((w-1)^2)
geometry.intervention: same diagonal bilinear features; signed weights versus nonnegative weights; exact convex ridge/bounded least squares

labels.reference: cleaned JEP v1.1 audited LLM-derived labels; not original human groundtruth
labels.human: no new verified conditional human labels

primary: Cross-family conditional retrieval and condition-switch accuracy, paired family bootstrap2000 draws, lexical control
reserve: Four frozen untouched families used for confirmation only of a single method selected on development; all choices logged before reserve evaluation.
leakage: Retain cleaned preexisting partitions. Backbone previously trained on cleaned train; validation/test remain previously examined exploratory reference evidence.
novelty: Conditional embeddings, moral geometry, CASE/SCS contrasts already exist. Test utility and controlled restrictions, no broad novelty/moral-reasoning claim.
